explanation: Mercury circles the Sun fastest of all the planets, yet it spins so slowly that one sunrise to the next takes about 176 Earth days, two of its years.

claims.text: Mercury orbits the Sun in about 88 Earth days.
Venus, Mars and Neptune each take longer than 88 Earth days to orbit the Sun.
Mercury moves faster along its orbit than any other planet.
On Mercury one solar day, from sunrise to sunrise, lasts about 176 Earth days, about two Mercury years.
